hypotheses.N0_route_subspace_matches_full_native_su: For both failures and controls, route-to-full rank-16 projector overlap has median >=0.80 and 10th percentile >=0.50.
hypotheses.N1_route_subspace_matches_full_finite_ef: For both failures and controls, route- versus full-subspace removal has median Fisher fidelity >=0.80 and 10th percentile >=0.50.
hypotheses.N2_full_native_subspace_beats_random: For both groups, full-subspace removal KL is at least 3x the within-site median of 32 matched random rank-16 subspaces.
hypotheses.N3_route_subspace_beats_random: For both groups, route-subspace removal KL is at least 2x the within-site median random KL.
hypotheses.N4_stable_route_object_is_native_relevan: N0 and N1 both pass; stability of the route surrogate then transfers to the full local model Jacobian.
